happened: The July 4, 2025 reconciliation law (the One Big Beautiful Bill Act) made 100 percent bonus depreciation permanent for property acquired on or after January 19, 2025. uncertain: No law or Treasury rule indexing capital gains for inflation was found. happened: The July 4, 2025 reconciliation law ended many green energy tax credits early. Electric vehicle credits ended after September 30, 2025, and home energy credits ended after 2025. uncertain: Whether the government appealed the ruling on Notice 2025-42 and what guidance replaced it. Exact end dates differ by one day across sources. Newest source: early 2026.

happened: Congress did not create Universal Savings Accounts for all taxpayers. happened: Congress let the Treasury buy more ownership in several international lenders. A funding law signed November 12, 2025 allowed up to 40,000 more paid-in shares of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development. The appropriations law signed February 3, 2026 allowed more shares of the Inter-American Investment Corporation, a $3.2 billion U.S. pledge to the World Bank's International Development Association, and a callable capital increase at the African Development Bank.

key_dates.event: P.L. 119-37 authorizes a U.S. capital increase at the EBRD.
P.L. 119-75 authorizes more shares in the IDB Invest and AfDB and the IDA replenishment.

closeness: The recommendation asked the U.S. to weigh raising or lowering its stakes to gain the most leverage. These laws raised some U.S. stakes; no decision to lower a stake, and no stated leverage strategy behind these steps, was found.
uncertain: Whether Treasury has completed the subscriptions was not checked. Treasury's reasons were not reviewed. Newest source: February 2026 law.

It writes Treasury's outbound investment program into law and expands it to cover China and other countries in chips, AI, quantum and other fields. Treasury must issue new rules by about March 2027.

happened: No rule making past participation in DEI programs grounds for firing Treasury employees was found. After the January 2025 executive order, OPM told agencies to put staff of DEI offices on leave and plan layoffs, and many were laid off across government. Lawsuits say some workers were chosen because of past DEI work rather than their current jobs.

key_dates.event: Executive order ending federal DEI programs signed.
Former federal employees file a class action in federal court in Washington, D.C. over DEI layoffs.

happened: On January 20, 2025, President Trump ordered withdrawal from the Paris Agreement; the withdrawal took effect on January 27, 2026. On January 7, 2026, a presidential memo began U.S. withdrawal from the U.N. Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) and 65 other international bodies. The U.N. received the formal UNFCCC notice on February 27, 2026, so that withdrawal takes effect on February 27, 2027.

key_dates.event: Executive order directs withdrawal from the Paris Agreement.

Treasury Secretary Bessent pressed the World Bank in September 2025 and again in October 2026 to drop its ban on financing upstream oil and gas projects. No Treasury program to promote domestic oil and gas investment was found.

happened: On January 30, 2025, Treasury's Federal Insurance Office left the Network for Greening the Financial System, a global group of regulators working on climate risk. On September 10, 2025, the Financial Stability Oversight Council, chaired by Treasury Secretary Bessent, ended its climate risk committee and advisory group. In October 2025 the bank regulators withdrew their climate risk principles for large banks.

uncertain: The $87 million fiscal 2026 amount is confirmed in Public Law 119-75 (February 3, 2026). The agency's project spending fell to $38 million in fiscal 2025, per a news report from August 2026.
